Metadata.Title: Dishonored 2
Metadata.Name: 1620p (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 2880x1620 output in PS4 Pro mode instead of 2560x1440, dynamic resolution as in the game and sharper anti-aliasing. Enable only one resolution entry.
Metadata.Author: gasb07

Metadata.Title: Dishonored 2
Metadata.Name: 1800p (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 3200x1800 output in PS4 Pro mode instead of 2560x1440, dynamic resolution as in the game and sharper anti-aliasing. Enable only one resolution entry.
Metadata.Author: gasb07

Metadata.Title: Dishonored 2
Metadata.Name: Native 4K (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 3840x2160 output in PS4 Pro mode instead of 2560x1440, full native 4K render (no dynamic resolution) and sharper anti-aliasing. GPU boost at 2200 MHz is recommended. Enable only one resolution entry.
Metadata.Author: gasb07

Metadata.Title: Dishonored 2
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: Unlocks the 30 fps cap. Works alone or with any resolution entry.
Metadata.Author: gasb07

Metadata.Title: Dishonored 2
Metadata.Name: 120 FPS
Metadata.Note: Runs the game above 60 fps, up to 120 fps depending on the scene and resolution. The manager turns on the 120 Hz video output when you enable it, and your TV or monitor must accept 120 Hz. Works alone or with any resolution entry. Only one frame rate entry can be on at a time.
Metadata.Author: gasb07

Metadata.Title: Dishonored 2
Metadata.Name: Skip intro videos
Metadata.Note: Skips the startup videos (legal, warning and logos).
Metadata.Author: gasb07
